title: H. A. Ironside Commentary Samples
author: H. A. Ironside
public_domain_status: Mixed source status. Romans first edition is 1928 and public domain in the United States. John and Luke source pages are verified, but full-text bulk import requires a copyright-renewal and edition audit.
commercial_use_status: Phase 2 includes curated summary entries only. Do not commercially redistribute full John or Luke source text until renewal, edition, and source terms are fully reviewed.
rights_basis: Use source-level metadata for each entry. Avoid modern edited editions and site-specific formatting. Treat this collection as sample-only until every selected source file has a complete rights review.
doctrinal_review_status: reviewed for Phase 2 sample use with discernment
recommended_use: Use as a second commentary voice after Scripture, Webster's 1828, TSK, people/place/type connections, and Matthew Henry. Keep collapsed by default so Scripture remains primary.
notes: Genesis 1 and Exodus 3 are intentionally not imported because a verified Ironside commentary source for those chapters was not found during Phase 2 source review.
